title: Title of the dialog that turns a finding on a Space page into a follow-up: a goal, a recurring schedule or a board issue.
description: The dialog's description. A "board issue" is an item on the workspace's Improvements board.
untitled: Default title for a page with no title, prefilled in the Title box.
fields.body: Label of the follow-up's text box (its description or prompt).
fields.destination: Label of the choice between a board issue, a recurring schedule and a goal.
fields.kind: Label of the issue's kind picker (bug, improvement…).
fields.area: Label of the issue's product area picker.
fields.no-area: The area picker's option for no area.
fields.repeat: Label of the schedule's interval picker: the time between one successful run and the next.
destinations.issue-hint: Triage is the board's first column, where new issues wait to be reviewed.
destinations.schedule-hint: A schedule runs a socio's (AI agent's) task repeatedly, each run in its own chat.
destinations.goal-hint: A specialist is the Space's socio (AI agent). The goal is set only once the person approves it.
goal-note: {{socio}} is the specialist socio's (AI agent's) name.
creating: The submit button while the follow-up is created.
submit.issue: Submit button that files the board issue.
submit.goal: Submit button that asks the socio (AI agent) to propose the goal.
toasts.filed: Toast after filing the issue. {{key}} is its key, like CB-42; don't translate it.
toasts.open: Button in the toast that opens what was created.
toasts.asked-detail: Under the toast's title. {{socio}} is the socio's (AI agent's) name.
errors.no-specialist: Error when the Space has no socio (AI agent) to run the schedule or goal.
